entry.title: New: BILL032(24) (Honolulu) — PUBLISH
entry.content:
RELATING TO NONDISCRIMINATION POLICY.

Updates the City’s policy prohibiting discrimination in the City’s employment practices and the provision of City services to align with current federal and state nondiscrimination statutes.

Latest action: Final reading notice published in the Honolulu Star-Advertiser.
